title: Kagamine Rin — The Reason We Met〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm bored...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How does Miku spend all her time here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Maybe Ena and the others will come here today...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You really can't draw unless someone appreciates your art?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I wonder what kind of art Ena's been making after that.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, it's...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hi, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You came again?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Should I have not?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I think you can come here whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But what brings you here today?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wanted to show you my drawing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your drawing?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. After that, I talked to Kanade and the others...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I drew something with the song Kanade made for me in mind.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, you brought it here for me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You sang that song for me too, so I thought I should show you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't know that's how you smiled.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I'm not...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Fine, fine. You can't fool me though...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think your drawing is nice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks... I couldn't have made it without you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I didn't do anything.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You were the one that refused to give up despite the pain you were feeling.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A compliment like that might throw me off a little...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wasn't really complimenting you. I was just saying what I thought was true.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What you thought was true, huh...? You even sound a little like her.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you may be right, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes. And I hope you'll keep trying your best.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, okay. I'm not gonna stop making songs with Kanade and the others anytime soon so...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (She'll keep making songs with them... From a different perspective, that could be seen as a sort of curse...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But for Ena, that may be a saving grace.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (It's proof that the bond between Ena and the others are real...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you gonna stay here in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you want me to be here, I will.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's that supposed to mean? You won't be here unless I ask you to?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I am pretty busy after all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you looked bored a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, I doubt I'll be asking too much of you, but I'd feel a lot better if you were here...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Plus, I'd feel bad if Miku kept on being alone here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh? You're worried about Miku too?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure. She's been helping us too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So... Try not to disappear on me like a certain someone just did with her friends, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're welcome.
